subject: OT: Description of facet chart in text

messages.author: 598eae3a5857142f
messages.subject: OT: Description of facet chart in text
parts:
Hi,

this is somewhat off topic but I was wondering how you guys are
normally handling it.
I stay away from facets but every now and then I use them. In latex I
include it via a figure, giving me one label/caption. And now I am
wondering how you normally describe a facet (ie. 3x2) in the free
flowing text? None of the 'rectangle boxes' in the chart (at least
when produced with ggplot2) have a specific ID, so how are you
referencing it? "When Headline A and Headline B are this and that"?

Thanks in advance.

Best,
Thomas

messages.author: 5196f936ff792c35
messages.subject: Re: OT: Description of facet chart in text
parts:
I primarily use facet_wrap(), but I suppose if I did have faceting by two variables then I would probably talk about my results in terms of when condition X and condition Y overlapped. Summarizing such large datasets in text form will not be easy though. 

Good luck. 

B
